caseNameFull: Topp v. Ferling, Superintendent, Maryland State Reformatory for Males
attorneys: Petitioner pro se., C. Ferdinand Sybert, Attorney General of Maryland, and James H. Norris, Jr., Special Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for writ of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
